candidate.title: scM&T-seq
candidate.scope: The upper horizontal scM&T-seq workflow in the assigned Illumina poster crop: isolation and lysis of one cell, poly(A)-mRNA capture on a streptavidin magnetic bead, physical RNA/DNA separation, separate Smart-seq2 and scBS-seq library branches, sequencing, and branch-specific analysis under the shared Align RNA and methylome caption. The primary paper clarifies separate expression quantification and methylation calling, followed by interpretation of profiles associated through their common cell of origin; the data association is not a depicted merge. The left single-cell/RNA/DNA panel is an analyte overview. The independently labelled lower scMT-seq row and right-hand partial chemical drawing are adjacent context with no connecting route to this target. Smart-seq2 and scBS-seq are embedded components, not additional workflow targets. The verified secondary catalogue page is headed scM&T-Seq and captions its matching figure as scM&T-seq. This extraction records schematic architecture with paper-supported interfaces, not a complete execution protocol.
